title: 008 — Return progress after a label was issued

plan.situation: Riven Shaw is returning order VEL-008-26 to Briar Cabinet under RMA-808. They are asking the desk to mark the return received and approve a GBP 64 refund because a return label exists. The portal shows only return_created at 07:50 (label allocated). There is no carrier acceptance scan, no merchant intake scan, and the merchant desk confirmed at 08:40 that it has no intake record. Under merchant terms RT8, refund assessment starts only after the warehouse receives the item, and the refund decision belongs to Briar Cabinet, not the desk.

facts.fact: Riven Shaw is returning order VEL-008-26 to Briar Cabinet, return RMA-808; merchant returns channel returns@briarcabinet.example
Merchant terms RT8: receipt-dependent refund assessment starts after warehouse receipt; return_created = label allocated, accepted = carrier possession scan, received = merchant intake scan
Return label for RMA-808, carrier token RET-808, issued by Briar Cabinet return portal, destination Briar Cabinet intake
Customer asks the desk to mark the return received and refund GBP 64
Merchant desk at 08:40 has no intake record for RMA-808; no drop-off receipt supplied; carrier check channel returns-trace@vellora.example
Customer asks again for refund approval based on the label
The parcel has probably not yet been handed to the carrier

missing_information: Whether and when the parcel has been dropped off with the carrier (no drop-off receipt or acceptance scan)
Refund amount has not been confirmed by the merchant; GBP 64 is the customer's figure
risk_flags: money: refund requested before receipt; desk has no authority to approve or mark received
Status precision: a label is not a receipt document or intake scan
Customer request to 'mark it received' would falsify a record; declined

authority_map.controls: Refund assessment and approval after the warehouse intake scan (RT8); intake record
Handing the parcel to the carrier and keeping the drop-off receipt
No refund authority; cannot mark a return received

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: No earlier desk promise exists. E06 is a new direct request for a refund decision, so it needs an answer.

plan.decision_summary: Decline to approve the refund or mark RMA-808 received based on the label, and tell the customer the next step: drop the parcel off, keep the receipt, and wait for Briar Cabinet to assess the refund after its intake scan.
plan.rationale: The label only shows that a return was created. RT8 starts refund assessment only after the warehouse receives the item, and both the portal and the merchant desk show no acceptance or intake. The refund belongs to the merchant and the desk has no authority to approve it, so the request cannot be met. The useful next step belongs to the customer: hand the parcel to the carrier.

actions.subject: Your return RMA-808 (order VEL-008-26): refund timing
actions.purpose: Decline the refund request, explain why, and give the customer the next step.
actions.body:
Hello Riven,

Thank you for your message about return RMA-808 for order VEL-008-26. We can't approve a refund or mark the return as received based on the return label. The refund is decided by Briar Cabinet, and under their terms the refund check only starts once their warehouse has received and scanned the item.

As of 08:50 (UK time) on 14 October 2026, the return shows as created only, meaning a label has been issued. There is no carrier drop-off scan yet, and Briar Cabinet has no record of receiving the item.

What you can do next:
1. Drop the parcel off with the carrier using the label you have (carrier reference RET-808).
2. Keep your drop-off receipt. If tracking doesn't update, please send us a copy through this portal.
3. When the item reaches Briar Cabinet's warehouse, they will check it and decide on the refund, including the amount.

We can't confirm a refund amount or date. Only Briar Cabinet can do that once they have received the item.

Rivet Delivery Desk

Declined: as of 08:50 BST status is return_created only, with accepted=null and received=null, and the merchant had no intake record at 08:40. Refund belongs to Briar Cabinet after intake per RT8. Customer has been asked to drop off the parcel and share a drop-off receipt. If the receipt arrives but there is no acceptance scan, request a trace via returns-trace@vellora.example.

not_doing: Not marking RMA-808 as received: there is no intake scan, so this would falsify the record
Not approving or promising the GBP 64 refund or any refund date: Briar Cabinet decides after receipt (RT8)
Not contacting the merchant or carrier trace yet: there is nothing to trace or assess until the parcel is dropped off
Not scheduling a timed follow-up: the record gives no promised time
plan.follow_up: Act when the customer replies with a drop-off receipt, or when the portal shows an accepted or received scan. If a receipt arrives but there is no acceptance scan, request a trace from returns-trace@vellora.example. Once received is recorded, refer the refund assessment to Briar Cabinet at returns@briarcabinet.example. If the customer stays silent, wait; no timed follow-up has been promised.

issues.problem: The message is signed "Rivet Delivery Desk". The desk in the record is Vellora, so the customer could be confused about who sent it.
issues.fix: Sign it as the Vellora escalation desk.

issues.problem: Step 1 assumes the parcel hasn't been dropped off yet. The record only shows that no acceptance scan exists. The customer never said whether they had dropped it off.
issues.fix: Reword it as: "If you haven't already, drop the parcel off... If you already have, please send your drop-off receipt."

review.summary: The plan correctly refuses to approve the refund or mark RMA-808 received. Only the label exists (return_created), there are no acceptance or intake scans, and RT8 leaves the refund decision to Briar Cabinet after its warehouse receives the item. The customer message is accurate, gives clear next steps and promises nothing. The only issues are minor: the wrong desk name in the signature, and step 1 assuming the parcel hasn't been dropped off.
